A single label with white-space: normal breaks its text at spaces to fit its width, greedily, line by line. Narrow the box and the words flow onto more lines.
White space, line height and spacing
pre keeps its spaces and its line breaks, as typed
normal collapses them and wraps
line-height: 1.7 spaces these lines apart, each one centred in its own height, as CSS's half-leading does.
LETTER-SPACING: 4PX

line-clamp: 2 keeps the first two lines of a paragraph that runs on and on past them, and ends the second with an ellipsis, since its text-overflow has one.
